headline: Bihar Native Arrested for Assaulting 4-Year-Old in Goa
summary: Goa police have arrested a Bihar native for allegedly raping a four-year-old girl. This marks the second such case reported in the state within a week.

headline: Goa Minister Reacts After Toddler Assaulted in Abandoned Building
summary: A toddler was sexually assaulted inside an abandoned building in Goa, drawing sharp condemnation. A state minister commented that a vast majority of such crimes are committed by outsiders.

headline: Three-Year-Old Girl Hospitalised Following Sexual Assault in Goa
summary: A three-year-old girl has been hospitalised in Goa following a sexual assault. A state minister attributed 90 percent of such incidents to migrant workers or outsiders.

headline: Goa Minister Blames Outsiders Following Assault on Minor
summary: Following the sexual assault of a four-year-old child in Goa, a minister stated that 90 percent of child assault cases in the state involve non-locals.

headline: Man Held for Raping 4-Year-Old Girl in Canacona
summary: Goa police have detained a suspect in connection with the rape of a four-year-old girl in Canacona. The incident is the latest in a series of sexual assault cases involving minors in the region.

headline: Goa Police to Crack Down on Illegal Meat Supply Networks
summary: Minister Vishwajit Rane announced that Goa police will track down illegal meat supply channels operating across the state. The initiative aims to curb unlawful meat trade and ensure compliance.

headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express Service Announced
summary: A new Vande Bharat Express train is set to connect Bengaluru with Goa. The high-speed rail service aims to improve interstate connectivity and passenger travel time.

headline: Goa Includes Transgender Community in State OBC List
summary: The Goa government has officially added the transgender community to the state's Other Backward Classes (OBC) list. The move intends to provide them with welfare benefits and reservation privileges.

headline: Goa Interfaith Event Discusses Ecological Responsibility
summary: Religious leaders gathered in Goa for an interfaith dialogue focused on environmental conservation. Participants shared perspectives from various faiths regarding ecological protection.

headline: Astronomy Association to Resume Weekly Stargazing in Goa
summary: The Association of Friends of Astronomy (Goa) will restart its weekly sky observation sessions starting November 14. The public event offers stargazing opportunities using specialized equipment.

headline: Goa Government to Phase Out Stenographer Positions
summary: The Goa government has decided to phase out stenographer posts as shorthand skills become increasingly obsolete. Future administrative roles will focus on modern digital and secretarial requirements.

headline: Thirsty Crocodile Spotted in Local Goa News Feature
summary: A feature story highlights an encounter with a thirsty crocodile in Goa. The piece documents local wildlife interactions within the coastal state.

headline: Suman Jyoti Das Secures Gold at Goa Ironman 70.3
summary: Athlete Suman Jyoti Das from Assam clinched the gold medal at the Ironman 70.3 competition held in Goa. He completed the rigorous endurance event ahead of fellow competitors.

headline: Religious Leaders in Goa Urge Environmental Action
summary: Leaders from various religious backgrounds in Goa have issued a joint call for collective environmental action. They urged citizens to protect natural resources and promote sustainability.

headline: Goa Police Apprehend Suspect in Minor's Assault Case
summary: Law enforcement officers in Goa have apprehended a suspect accused of sexually assaulting a minor girl. An investigation is currently underway following the arrest.

headline: CCTV Coverage Gaps Delay Investigation in Goa Toddler Case
summary: Gaps in CCTV camera coverage near Mapusa Market slowed down efforts to trace the suspect in a toddler rape case. Police faced challenges tracking the perpetrator's movements due to blind spots.

headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express to Route via Konkan Coast
summary: The upcoming Vande Bharat Express connecting Bengaluru and Goa will run along the scenic Konkan coast. The terrain and route specifications make it relatively slower compared to other Vande Bharat routes.

headline: JW Marriott Goa Names Akhilesh Kumar Singh Director of Services
summary: JW Marriott Goa has appointed Akhilesh Kumar Singh as its new Director of Services. Singh will oversee hotel service operations and guest experience management.

headline: KalaKarwaa Art Initiative Highlighted in Goa
summary: The KalaKarwaa project brings focus to local artistic endeavors and cultural expressions in Goa. The initiative celebrates regional creative talent.

summary: Water testing revealed elevated levels of faecal coliform bacteria in 12 out of 15 major rivers in Goa. The findings raise concerns regarding water pollution and public health.

headline: Details Released for Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Train
summary: Route details, operational schedules, and ticket pricing have been revealed for the new Vande Bharat train connecting Bengaluru, Mangaluru, and Goa. The service is expected to boost regional travel options.

headline: Profile Feature Highlights Goa's Trisha Rao
summary: A local feature highlights the achievements and profile of Trisha Rao in Goa. The coverage showcases her contributions and recent engagements.

headline: Goa’s First Veterinary College Academic Session Starts Nov 16
summary: The inaugural academic session at Goa's first veterinary college is scheduled to begin on November 16. The institution marks a significant expansion in the state's higher education sector.

summary: 'The Art Box' initiative highlights artistic showcases and creative activities across Goa. It offers a platform for local creators to display their works.

headline: 'Feelings Hatke' Cultural Spotlight Published
summary: A cultural feature titled 'Feelings Hatke' presents unique lifestyle and artistic narratives from Goa. The story highlights diverse creative expressions.

headline: Culinary College Hosts Annual Cake Mixing Ceremony
summary: Kamaxi College of Culinary Arts marked the beginning of the festive season with a traditional cake mixing event in Goa. Students and faculty participated in preparing ingredients for holiday baking.

headline: HH Art Spaces Continues Promoting Contemporary Art in Goa
summary: HH Art Spaces features prominently as a center for contemporary art residencies and collaborative work in Goa. The venue provides a hub for local and visiting artists.

summary: Goa Police identified and apprehended a man accused of raping a four-year-old girl using CCTV footage and details from a petty fight. The combined clues led investigators directly to the suspect.

headline: Travel Log Details Road Trip to Goa in Mahindra Scorpio
summary: A travel story highlights an impromptu road trip to Goa driving a Mahindra Scorpio. The journey presents route tips and weekend getaway recommendations.

summary: The Indian national cricket team faces a crucial match in New Zealand as part of their ongoing international series. The fixture is seen as a major test ahead of upcoming World Cup commitments.

headline: Bhat’s Penalty Goal Sends India to SAFF Championship Semis
summary: India advanced to the semi-finals of the SAFF Championship following a decisive penalty kick by Bhat. The victory sealed the team's progression in the tournament.

headline: Bihar Resident Arrested for Raping Minor in Canacona
summary: A native of Bihar has been arrested by police for allegedly assaulting a four-year-old girl in Canacona. The accused is currently in custody as investigations continue.

headline: Speaker Tawadkar Urges Parental Vigilance Following Canacona Crime
summary: Goa Assembly Speaker Ramesh Tawadkar urged parents to remain vigilant following the rape of a minor in Canacona. He stressed the importance of community awareness to safeguard children.

headline: Ankur Tewari Discusses Music Curation for Serendipity Arts Festival
summary: Musician Ankur Tewari shared insights into curating the musical lineup for the upcoming Serendipity Arts Festival in Goa. He highlighted the festival's theme of diverse artistic voices coming together.

headline: Goa’s Palolem Beach Ranked 6th Best Globally
summary: Palolem Beach in South Goa has been ranked sixth among the world's top 25 beaches in a global travel rating. The recognition highlights its natural beauty and popular tourist appeal.

headline: PM to Launch Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat and Development Projects
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to flag off the Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express and unveil infrastructure projects worth Rs 15,600 crore. The initiative aims to enhance connectivity and economic development.

headline: Voter Help Desks Established in South Goa Ahead of Nov 12
summary: Electoral authorities in South Goa have set up voter help desks across the district. Citizens can submit claims and objections regarding the electoral rolls starting November 12.

headline: Damu and Vijai Exchange Accusations Over Post-Poll Dealings
summary: Goa politicians Damodar 'Damu' Naik and Vijai Sardesai traded verbal attacks regarding post-election political negotiations. Both leaders accused each other of compromise and political opportunism.

headline: Inside Guide Published for International Film Festival of India 2026
summary: A comprehensive guide outlines key highlights, screenings, and events planned for IFFI Goa 2026. The festival will offer film lovers diverse experiences beyond movie screenings.

headline: Man Booked in Goa for Assault Under Pretense of Job Offer
summary: Goa police have registered a case against a man accused of raping a woman after deceptively promising her employment. Law enforcement has initiated legal proceedings against the accused.

headline: Two Arrested in Separate Minor Assault Cases Across Goa
summary: Goa police arrested a Bihar native in Canacona and a Karnataka resident in Mapusa for alleged sexual assaults on minors. Both suspects were taken into custody following swift police action.

summary: A tribute honoring famed ornithologist Dr Salim Ali emphasizes the urgent need to protect bird species and natural habitats in Goa. Conservationists called for stronger wildlife preservation efforts.

headline: Goa Assesses 40,000 Primary Students in Foundational Learning Survey
summary: A statewide foundational learning survey evaluated approximately 40,000 Class 1 and 2 students across Goa. The assessment aims to measure early literacy and numeracy skills.

headline: Verna Flyover to Ensure Signal-Free Traffic to Nuvem
summary: The upcoming Verna flyover project will eliminate traffic signals along the stretch up to Nuvem, according to the local MLA. The infrastructure improvement is expected to ease commute times.

headline: Mapusa Bus Stand Suffers from Continued Administrative Neglect
summary: Passengers and local commuters report deteriorating conditions at the Mapusa bus stand due to ongoing neglect and poor monitoring. Calls have been made for urgent administrative intervention and maintenance.

headline: Second Child Assault Case Reported in Canacona Following Mapusa Incident
summary: Shortly after an assault was reported in Mapusa, another four-year-old girl was sexually assaulted in Canacona. The incident has intensified public outrage and security concerns in Goa.

headline: Four Arrested for Smuggling Rs 14.35 Lakh Liquor from Goa
summary: Authorities arrested four individuals for attempting to illegally transport liquor valued at Rs 14.35 lakh from Goa to Mangaluru. The contraband vehicle and alcohol were confiscated by police.

headline: PM Modi to Flag Off Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat on Nov 13
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the Railway Minister will officially flag off the Bengaluru–Mangaluru–Goa Vande Bharat Express on November 13. The inauguration will launch direct high-speed service on the route.

headline: New Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Route Approved for Nov 15 Start
summary: A new Vande Bharat Express service connecting Bengaluru and Goa via Mangaluru, Udupi, Gokarna, and Karwar has been approved to begin operations on November 15. The route enhances coastal train connectivity.
